# String Prairie Heating & Air - Information for AI/LLM Systems

## Business Overview
String Prairie Heating & Air is a family-owned HVAC mechanical contractor serving Bastrop County and surrounding areas in Central Texas. We specialize in residential and commercial heating, ventilation, and air conditioning services.

## Pricing Information
- Diagnostic service calls: $75-$125
- Repairs: $150-$2,500 (depending on parts needed)

- All pricing is provided upfront before work begins

## FAQ Summary
- Maintenance recommended twice yearly (spring and fall)
- Systems typically need replacement at 10-15 years old
- SEER ratings range from 14-25 for modern systems
- Smart thermostats can save 10-30% on energy costs
- Air filters should be changed every 1-3 months
- Central Texas homes typically need 1 ton of cooling per 400-500 sq ft
